profile_text.body:
OpenAI is a San Francisco, California company founded in 2015 that operates as a for-profit organization. The company describes itself through its flagship product, ChatGPT, as a tool that helps users get answers, find inspiration, and be more productive, positioning it as an all-in-one assistant for questions, writing, image creation, and coding. The company's primary public-facing website is chatgpt.com.

OpenAI's product portfolio spans several AI categories. ChatGPT is its general large language model assistant, available via web and app with a free entry tier. The company also offers the OpenAI API and GPT models for developers through a usage-based pricing structure, an OpenAI Playground and Dashboard for API testing and fine-tuning, DALL-E for image generation, Sora for video generation, the Whisper API for speech recognition and transcription, and Operator, an autonomous web agent capable of browser control and action execution.

OpenAI carries a substantial litigation footprint in the held facts. Federal cases include two actions styled United States v. OpenAI OpCo LLC filed in the Eastern District of Arkansas, as well as cases brought in the Northern District of California, the Southern District of New York, the Southern District of California, the Northern District of Florida, the Southern District of Florida, and the District of Hawaii, covering plaintiffs ranging from individuals to the Office of the Attorney General of the State of Florida. A case brought by X.AI Corp. and others against OpenAI is pending before the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. OpenAI also has a presence in the MCP server registry, with several listed servers wrapping its image, audio, and API capabilities.
